# WaterQuest Solutions

WaterQuest Solutions designs oil-free water hydraulic systems using tap water or seawater as the hydraulic medium.

Core sections:
- Products: /products
- Industries: /industries
- Applications: /applications
- Hydraulic Calculations: /calculations
- Technical Glossary: /glossary
- Technology: /technology
- Knowledge Hub: /knowledge-hub
- About: /about

Important concepts:
- Water as a hydraulic medium
- Oil-free hydraulic systems
- 316 stainless steel and carbon-reinforced PEEK materials
- Pumps, motors, cylinders, valves, HPUs, fire pumps, desalination, marine, municipal, mining, food, fire suppression, wastewater, hydroelectric, and hydrogen applications
